title: The maximum concentration of results in incomplete round-robin tournaments
abstract: arXiv:2611.01750v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The Herfindahl--Hirschman Index (HHI), a standard measure of market concentration, is widely used to quantify competitive balance in sports tournaments. To enable comparisons over time or across leagues, both its minimum and maximum should be known. The minimum is usually trivial. Our paper provides results on the maximum HHI in incomplete round-robin tournaments, where the set of matches is represented by a regular but not complete undirected graph. We prove that the lower bound of maximum HHI is reached when the tournament consists of independent round-robin groups, while the upper bound of maximum HHI is reached when the set of matches is represented by a bipartite graph. Maximising HHI is computationally difficult even for highly structured graph types corresponding to real-world tournaments, where the teams are partitioned into pots and play the same number of matches against opponents from every pot. translated_title: 不完全循环赛中比赛结果的最大集中度
translated_abstract: 赫芬达尔—赫希曼指数（HHI）是衡量市场集中度的标准指标，被广泛用于量化体育赛事中的竞争平衡。为了实现跨时间或跨联赛的比较，需要同时知道该指数的最小值和最大值。最小值通常是显而易见的，而本文给出了不完全循环赛中最大HHI的相关结果，其中比赛集合由正则但非完全的无向图表示。我们证明，当锦标赛由相互独立的循环赛小组构成时，最大HHI的下界得以达到；而当比赛集合由二部图表示时，最大HHI的上界得以达到。即使对于与现实世界赛制相对应的高度结构化的图类型——即球队被划分为多个档次，并与来自每个档次的对手进行相同数量的比赛——最大化HHI在计算上依然是困难的。该问题的复杂度……
tldr: 本文研究了不完全循环赛中衡量竞争集中度的赫芬达尔—赫希曼指数（HHI）的最大值问题，证明其下界在独立小组循环赛结构下达到、上界在二部图赛程结构下达到，并指出即使在球队分档、结构高度规则的现实赛制下，最大化HHI仍是计算困难的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes the maximum Herfindahl–Hirschman Index (HHI) in incomplete round-robin tournaments, proving that its lower bound is attained when the tournament consists of independent round-robin groups and its upper bound when the match graph is bipartite, and showing that maximizing HHI is computationally hard even for highly structured real-world tournament designs where teams are partitioned into pots.
